title: 143. Partition Labels

examples.explanation: The maximal split is ababcbaca, defegde, hijhklij.
All characters in the string appear within a single contiguous segment, so the partition is [10].
Each character appears in its own contiguous segment, so the partition is [1,1,1].

hints: Record the last index where each letter occurs.
Scan from left to right while extending the current part's end to the latest final occurrence seen so far.
When the scan reaches that end, close the part immediately to maximize the total number of parts.
